notes.title: Global Update By YAGZZ!
notes.notes:
We made a global update in which the previous game was replaced by YAGZZ! This is a cool, interesting platformer in which a black guy collects souls and crushes his enemies.
Were added:
* To start 30 interesting levels
* 3 difficulty levels and 3 languages
* 35 Steam Achievements
* About 10 kinds of enemies and even more traps
* Coming another global update in which the levels, achievement and all of this list will increase: D
Stay with us and you will be satisfied with the following interesting updates of this fascinating game! :)))
